description.value: Macy's Herald Square is the flagship department store building on West 34th Street at Herald Square. Wikipedia says the building has a floor area of about 2.2 million square feet, making it the largest department store in the United States and one of the largest in the world. It also notes that the store boasts several wooden escalators still in operation, a detail worth seeking out between floors. Allow at least an hour to cover fashion, home and beauty. Representative Tripadvisor praise (search snapshot): “The store is huge and has the most beautiful Christmas displays in the windows”. Representative watch-outs: “I tend to get lost in and have difficulties finding the things I am looking for”. Tripadvisor shows 4 of 5 bubbles (4,988 reviews) for the 151 West 34th Street store.
